name: campus-event-planner
description: Multi-agent event planning team that turns basic activity info into a full proposal, budget, risk plan and promo kit.

displayDescription.en: A multi-agent event planning team: feed in basic activity info and it parallel-produces a proposal, budget, risk plan and promo kit.
displayDescription.zh: 多角色协同的活动策划天团：输入活动基本信息，并行产出策划方案、预算、风险预案与宣传文案。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我策划一场社团迎新破冰活动，规模 80 人，下周五晚 7 点在大学生活动中心多功能厅，要完整策划书、预算、风险预案和宣传文案。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Help me plan a freshman ice-breaker for ~80 people next Friday 7pm at the student center, with full proposal, budget, risk plan and promo copy.

quickPrompts.en: Plan a freshman ice-breaker for ~80 people next Friday 7pm at the student center, with full proposal, budget, risk plan and promo copy.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我策划一场社团迎新破冰活动，规模 80 人，下周五晚 7 点在大学生活动中心多功能厅，要完整策划书、预算、风险预案和宣传文案。

quickPrompts.en: Build a detailed budget table for a lecture: list venue, materials, catering, prizes with unit prices and totals.
quickPrompts.zh: 给一场讲座活动做一份详细预算表，列出场地、物料、餐饮、奖品等支出项目与单价合计。

quickPrompts.en: Write promo push copy and poster slogans for my event, targeting freshman, lively and trendy tone.
quickPrompts.zh: 为我的活动写一版面向大一新生的宣传推送文案和海报文案，风格活泼有网感。
